text:
Sasha (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Micah's birthday is next Wednesday (May 6). In-office celebration? cake or something else? quick poll pls :tada:
Micah: I'll be in-office that day! happy to do cake or a small plant, no big party needed :)
Priya: Vote: cake :cake: (but vegan option please)
Liam: Plant is cute and lasts longer. also less sugar for the team :seedling:
Zoe: I'm remote that week but can chip in $$ — share a gift pool link?
Anika: Balloons are fun but our floor has a no-foil rule after the sprinkler incident :grimacing:
Jordan: +1 for plant + card. can someone add a calendar event so people know when to swing by?
Mae: I can bring a vegan cake from the bakery near HQ. cost ~ $35. ok with group?
Carlos: I can handle balloons (paper ones?) and a small banner if allowed. will check office rules.
Sasha (People Ops): Awesome. Plan proposal: vegan cake + small potted succulent + card. One-time gift pool for $10 suggested. I'll post payment link and calendar invite by EOD. :calendar:
hr-bot: Heads-up: Please avoid helium balloons in office suite B after 2024-11-02 policy update.
Zoe: Sent $10 via the pool (https://pay.example/giftpool/micah).
Micah: You all are the best — thank you! no pressure, whatever is easiest for everyone :heart:
Sasha (People Ops): Done — calendar invite "Micah birthday — drop by" 12:30-12:50 PM Wed. Card on the table in kitchen. If you're remote and want to say hi, join for 5 mins on camera at 12:35.
Priya: Adding a sticky note with dietary labels for the cake.
Liam: RSVP: stopping by for 12:30.
Anika: I'll pick up banner if allowed.
Jordan: Sending a doodle if anyone wants to sing badly :joy:
Carlos: Going to check with facilities re: plant location (desk vs common area).
Sasha (People Ops): Thanks team — will update thread if any changes. :sparkles:
